name: Plunk Cloud Free
free_limit: 1,000 hosted emails per month across transactional, marketing, workflow and inbound messages; unlimited contacts, custom domains, API/SMTP and automations.
watch_out: Free hosted tier includes Plunk branding in marketing emails; 1,000-email allowance also counts inbound messages. Exceeding the free allowance requires upgrading to paid usage at $0.001/email; self-hosting requires separately paid infrastructure and email delivery. Commercial use on the hosted free plan is not expressly confirmed in the reviewed pricing and billing pages.
